messages:
Lena Ortiz: Hi team, my wallet was stolen in St. Julian's (Malta) and I need an urgent CT scan today. Clinic says they need proof of coverage or a company confirmation to bill insurer. I only have a screenshot of my digital card in the app that shows my name but not policy number. Can you help fast?

People Ops: Sorry to hear that, Lena. We can send a verification email to the imaging center and produce a temporary digital ID that includes coverage dates. Do you want us to email them or provide a printable PDF? Please send clinic name, email, and any receipt/estimate you have.

Lena Ortiz: Clinic: St. Julian Imaging, billing@stjimaging.mt. They sent an estimate in EUR for CT Abdomen (est_ct_2026.jpg). Please email, I don't have a printer.

Claims Team: Quick checklist for urgent imaging:
- Estimate or appointment confirmation (photo ok)
- Passport photo or police report if theft occurred
- Card transaction screenshot if you pay out-of-pocket
- Short English translation of any non-English docs

Benefits Bot: Tip: use the portal -> Travel & Foreign -> "Urgent Verification" to tag priority. 

People Ops: Sending email now to billing@stjimaging.mt with claim ref 1905554321. We will redact policy numbers and include benefits verification phone +1-555-0199. ETA: email + temp ID PDF to your inbox in 60 minutes.

Imaging Center - St. Julian: Auto-reply received. If employer verification is emailed we can proceed. For direct billing we require: signed provider invoice, clinic VAT number, and an English line-item. We can accept scanned docs via email.

Lena Ortiz: Thank you. Also the clinic asked if Redwood can provide an authorization number or PO for direct billing. Is that possible?

Claims Team: We can attempt Direct Pay for imaging centers. It requires clinic VAT number (local tax id) and finance approval. If you want direct billing, please ask the clinic to include their VAT and bank details in the invoice and mark "Direct Bill Request" in the email. Otherwise pay and upload receipts for reimbursement (we reimburse in USD using service-date FX).

People Ops: Email sent and temp ID emailed to lena. We included instructions for the clinic to send VAT and invoice to claims@redwood.com for direct-pay consideration. We also uploaded copies to Lena's portal folder.

Lena Ortiz: Received the temp ID and the clinic replied they will send a VAT-enabled invoice and can bill directly. Thanks so much for the quick help!

Benefits Bot: Reminder: if you travel, enable "pre-travel docs" in portal to generate a pre-approved verification PDF before departure.
